rules: Readiness GET never invokes predict or creates a journal entry
History requires all nine exact pre-meal offsets; conflicts and off-grid samples block inference
The model health probe uses bounded timeouts and a five-second cache; readiness is not a guarantee of scoring success
latestReceivedAt is a receipt wall-clock timestamp, not a CGM observation timestamp; legacy null receipts remain unknown
The configured synthetic replay baseline does not move with the wall clock
Same event ID and identical patient, timestamp, value and source is idempotent; changed content returns HTTP 409
History readiness is independent of model availability; unavailable scoring attempts can still be saved
